objective: Generate legitimate operating revenue from existing SATA transparency infrastructure and allocate approved proceeds toward the 1,000,000,000 sats reserve target.

agentCan: prepare prospect lists from public information
prepare invoices or payment instructions for chairman approval
prepare reserve or liquidity allocation proposals
agentCannot: hold private keys or seed phrases
move BTC, SOL, SATA, USDC, or LP tokens
promise revenue, price, liquidity, return, redemption, or market support
approve paid promotion or token compensation

currentAssetsToUse: SATA social account and approved-only content queue
existing public credibility from locked liquidity and disclosed reserve

revenueStreams.label: SATA Transparency Audit
revenueStreams.deliverable: Authority analysis, supply and concentration review, LP ownership or lock analysis, reserve-claim verification, risk disclosures, machine-readable JSON, and a public or private final report.
revenueStreams.paymentTiming: chairman-approved BTC invoice before final delivery, or chairman-approved escrow terms

revenueStreams.label: Transparency report setup
revenueStreams.deliverable: Repo-based public report template, disclosure checklist, deployment instructions, and first reporting refresh for a client project.
revenueStreams.paymentTiming: 50% upfront only after chairman approval, 50% after delivery

revenueStreams.label: Continuous transparency monitoring
revenueStreams.deliverable: Hosted recurring monitoring with automated public report workflow, proof dashboard, public JSON endpoints, monthly evidence refresh, and operating runbook.
revenueStreams.paymentTiming: monthly recurring only after chairman-approved scope, invoice, and cancellation terms

upgradePolicy.objective: Increase average deal value only after a customer validates the $249 audit and asks for implementation help or recurring monitoring.
defaultPath: Start with the $249 SATA Transparency Audit unless the customer already asks for a setup or monitoring scope.
Offer the $999 transparency report setup when the audit finds public-reporting gaps the customer wants fixed.
Offer the $4999/month continuous transparency monitoring plan only when the customer wants recurring automated public reporting.
qualificationQuestions: Do you only want the gap report, or do you want help setting up the public report?
Do you need a one-time report template or an automated dashboard/workflow?
Who will approve public wording, payment terms, and final deployment on your side?
stopRules: Do not pressure a customer into a larger scope.
Do not imply the work will improve SATA price, client token price, liquidity, trading volume, or buyer demand.
Do not start paid work or send payment instructions before chairman-approved scope and invoice.

requiredEvidence: client or counterparty identifier when public or internally recorded

goToMarketRules: Revenue First: do not build major new SATA subsystems until the team attempts to sell the existing audit offer, except for defects, security issues, or customer blockers.
Lead with proof tooling and public reporting, not SATA price action.
Use Sponsored/Paid Partnership disclosure for any paid or token-compensated SATA coverage.
Prefer public, factual deliverables over engagement promises.
Do not buy fake engagement, bots, raids, or investor lists.
Do not sell hidden token allocations or make undisclosed compensation arrangements.

successCriteria: at least one paid $249 SATA Transparency Audit
four attempted $249 audit closes or one closed customer, whichever comes first
chairman-approved allocation proposal for any received funds
track Customers, Revenue, Reserve sats, and Recurring revenue

planningAssumptions.btcUsdSource: operator planning assumption, not a live quote
planningAssumptions.reserveImpactRule: Use only for planning outreach priority and reserve-impact estimates. Quote exact sats from a fresh chairman-selected BTC/USD rate only after a customer explicitly asks for an invoice.
planningAssumptions.actualSatsRule: Planning only. Record actual sats only after confirmed receipt and chairman-approved allocation.

prohibitedRoutes: fake engagement, bots, raids, or investor lists
using the reserve as a guaranteed price floor
using private keys or seed phrases in an agent workflow

publicLanguage.allowed: SATA sells transparency tooling and public-reporting services while building its own proof-first treasury discipline.
publicLanguage.requiredCaveat: No price guarantee, no redemption promise, no revenue guarantee, and no market-support commitment.
